summary: Give the card back, with the token alone. A holder releases on every way out - done, cancelled, refused, crashed and recovered. THE RELEASE IS CHECKED: it is answered once every process the rental still names is gone and - where the coordinator can read the card - the card's memory is back to what it read when the rental was granted; where it cannot read the card, the processes gone suffice. A process still there after the coordinator's settle time (`limits.settle_s` on `/state`, 10 s unless it was started with another) is ended on its proof, and the record names each. Only then is the card offered to the next ticket in line, and while the check runs the rental is `releasing` on `/state`. The answer is the rental as it was released: `state` is `released`, and `processes` what it named. Releasing a rental that is already over is refused with the reason, so a holder learns whether it gave the card back or had it taken. A ticket that was never claimed is cancelled, not released.
